title: Why don't Graph Transformers attend to the same token?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In large language models (LLMs), attention concentrates heavily on the first token. This 'attention sink' is believed to protect deep models against over-mixing. Even though graph transformers face a related pressure, we find that a SoTA graph transformer, GRIT, rarely forms sinks on molecules, and that it sinks less when trained on larger graphs, the opposite of the trend in LLMs. In principle, a graph can prevent sinks: we prove and show empirically that its symmetry and locality limit the attention any node can receive. On molecules, however, with distinguishable atoms and global attention, neither limit prevents sinks; what stops them lies in the model. We find that the attention scoring function is the main cause. Replacing GRIT's gated logit with a dot product raises its sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68 on identical graphs. In Graph Transformers using dot-product attention, removing the sink gives about the same error as removing a rand

translated_title: 为什么图Transformer不会将注意力集中于同一个token？
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）中，注意力高度集中于第一个token，这种“注意力汇聚”现象被认为可以保护深层模型免受过度混合的影响。尽管图Transformer面临着类似的结构性压力，我们发现最先进的图Transformer GRIT在分子数据上很少形成注意力汇聚，且在更大的图上训练时汇聚程度反而更低，这与LLM中的趋势恰好相反。从原理上讲，图结构本身可以防止注意力汇聚：我们从理论和实验上证明了图的对称性和局部性会限制任何节点所能接收的注意力。然而，对于具有可区分原子和全局注意力的分子而言，这两个限制都无法阻止汇聚；真正阻止汇聚的因素在于模型内部。我们发现注意力评分函数是主要原因：将GRIT的门控logit替换为点积后，在相同的图上其汇聚率从0.09升至0.68。在使用点积注意力的图Transformer中，移除汇聚token所产生的误差与移除一个随机token大致相同。
tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型中的“注意力汇聚”现象在图Transformer中罕见的原因——图的对称性与局部性在理论上可限制注意力集中，而对使用全局注意力的分子任务，真正阻止汇聚的是GRIT的门控注意力评分函数，将其替换为点积后汇聚率从0.09飙升至0.68。
en_tdlr: This paper explains why graph transformers rarely form the "attention sink" phenomenon seen in LLMs: while graph symmetry and locality theoretically limit attention concentration, the key preventer for molecules with global attention is GRIT's gated attention scoring function—replacing it with a dot product raises the sink rate from 0.09 to 0.68.
